body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one enemy within weapon range. You suffer -1 Defense against it until your next turn; on a success, deal 1 weapon damage and make it Exposed.

surges.html: On a success, make the target Exposed.

rider.title: GAMBIT CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target takes the offered attack against you. Effect: After it resolves, gain +1 die on your next Action against it.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
